question: #12628 at 3bbaf48b against main: do hover and focus overlays look the same, let Tab reach their actions, expose only what Tab reaches, take no click before they show, and hide after their fade?

stories.image: core-overlay--hover-on-image (the same story on both builds)
stories.modes: core-overlay--reveal-modes (new in the head, so main has none)

method.layer: the overlay's .astryx-overlay-scrim element; opacity, visibility, clip-path and pointer-events are its computed values; hit: elementFromPoint at the action's center returns the action or a child
method.tab: focus starts on the page; Tab until focus leaves the story; each stop is sampled on every frame for 400 ms, timed from focusin
method.ring: the focused action's outline band on its straight edges, every pixel row across the band; each pixel against the pixel 1.5 px outside the band and the pixel in the middle of the gap inside it (WCAG contrast ratio)
method.ax: Chromium's full accessibility tree at rest (CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree); each non-ignored node mapped to its DOM element; a node inside an action counts as that action
method.hover: the pointer enters the image 24 px in from its corner, away from the action; every frame from pointerenter for 600 ms
method.unhover: the overlay shown by hover for 600 ms, then the pointer leaves; every frame from pointerleave for 600 ms; reduced motion off and on
method.touch: a tap 24 px in from the image's corner, twice, 700 ms apart
